snippet.title: Saturn 9 Indie Game Trailer
snippet.description:
Greenlight for The Saturn 9 Collection: http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=174924076
Saturn 9 is a sci-fi horror game for Xbox 360 Indie Games. Investigate the spaceship Saturn 9, solve puzzles to progress through the ship. Uncover the mystery of what happened to the crew.


Track Name: Horra's Horror (Orchestral Tension)
Composer: Marcus Dellicompagni
Website: www.RedAudioUK.com
